method: 2x2 same-state display chance-channel masking × midpoint/lower immediate-damage heuristic
collection: seeds0..9, first3 actual battle decisions by TAKE; no preparation/support/encounter mutation
mask: only chanceText becomes common [0,100]%; damageText/outcome/action availability retained, so not all pitch information is removed
tieRule: first legal action in basic/hand order then zone0..8; optimum sets and margins reported to expose arbitrary ties
hypothesis: Displayed chance or objective can change optimal action set in this fixed sample; zero disjoint sets is a valid negative result, not a failing software gate.
limits: No take/preparation/support alternatives in chooser; core card strategy not exhaustively tested.
No exact EV or sampled outcome optimization; no win-rate/long-run cost analysis.
Damage interval midpoint is a heuristic, not mathematical expected damage.
Lower-endpoint heuristic is not survival or two-strike-optimal play.
No slider/curve-specific current engine mechanic inferred from visual labels.
No human readability, enjoyment or physical-device evidence.
